description: Shows what a chat, voice or phone caller project tests: its scenarios with title, persona, category, a short description and the suites each belongs to. Narrow to one suite, one chat agent, or scenarios mentioning some text. Name one scenario to get it in full, including its expected outcomes. Searches one project at a time.

agent.description: Chat agent name or ID, for a project with several chat agents.

project.description: Project name (all or part of it) or ID.

query.description: Only scenarios whose text mentions this.

scenario.description: Scenario ID, or all or part of its title, to get that one scenario in full.

suite.description: Suite name (all or part of it) or ID. Only the scenarios in this suite.

name: agent_testing_find_scenarios
title: Find Agent Testing Scenarios
